== Trivia ==
[[Image:Frog Scepter Concept Art.jpg|100px|thumb|The concept art for this wand]]
* This weapon is based on the winning design by Zane Bryan from the [[Design-a-Weapon (2007)|Design-a-Weapon Contest]] held in 2007.
* ''Froggy'' is the common nickname for this item.
* Due to its unique appearance and low drop rate, the Frog Scepter can be a quite valuable item.
